thesportsdb.note: Free JSON API. Current public database pages show all nine target sports/competition families. Best suited to cross-sport event/participant/league/venue/standings enrichment rather than Opta-depth event statistics. A current independent 2026 implementation reports silently truncated free-tier responses (for example, partial league tables) in some cases; therefore every response must be completeness-checked against expected counts or independent sources before feature use.

espn_public.note: Public ESPN API documentation/implementations expose broad coverage across basketball, racing, tennis, MMA, rugby and volleyball, plus rosters, injuries, transactions, news and statistics. Treat the surface as public/undocumented and reconstruct availability conservatively.

odds_api_io.note: Provider advertises a free tier of 100 requests/hour and 500/day across 34 sports. Direct pages confirm basketball, tennis, MMA including Rizin, boxing, rugby and Valorant/esports. Use only as market-signal enrichment; bookmaker publication timestamps are required for historical PIT.
odds_api_io.terms_note: Current free-tier page states free is for development/testing/personal projects; commercial production requires paid access. Keep out of commercial production unless terms permit.

specialist_open_datasets.note: Open datasets can add higher-granularity research features but often lack historical availability timestamps. Keep PIT-gated.

f1_community_dataset.note: Community F1 dataset currently reports 1950-2026 coverage and CC0 licensing; use as redundancy/research corpus rather than replacing OpenF1/Jolpica.

cross_sport_context.note: Non-sport-specific context sources can improve venue conditions, travel/rest context, entity resolution and external-information awareness across multiple target sports. They remain separate from direct match-stat feeds.

open_meteo.pit: forecast-run timestamp required for prediction replay

sportscore.note: Documented public REST API covering football, basketball, cricket and tennis; no API key for open-source/attribution use, with an advertised free quota. Useful as an independent redundancy source for basketball/tennis.

discovery_aggregator.note: mcp-sports-hub aggregates 40+ providers and identifies no-key/free providers. It is used as a provider-discovery index only, not as a production data source.

api_sports.note: API-Sports currently advertises a permanent free plan with 100 requests/day for each API, no credit card, with dedicated APIs covering basketball, volleyball, MMA, Formula 1 and rugby. Registration/API key is required. Use as secondary redundancy only until exact historical availability, PIT timestamps and source terms are validated.

ufcstats.note: UFCStats exposes public UFC event/fight pages with detailed historical fight statistics. There is no official public API, so any scraper must be rate-limited, provenance-preserving and PIT-audited. Suitable as an independent UFC historical redundancy source, not a production feed by default.

openboxing.note: Open Boxing publishes its underlying boxing data as GitHub CSV files and exposes a basic JSON API. The project itself warns it is early development with possible missing/error data, so it is a redundancy/research corpus pending quality, provenance and terms validation.

rugby_data_repository.note: Rugby-Data is a public JSON/YAML corpus covering multiple professional rugby union competitions, with weekly automated updates; historical depth varies by competition. Use for redundancy/feature enrichment after snapshot and PIT validation.

f1api_dev.note: F1API.dev is an independent free/no-key F1 REST API with current and historical structured race, qualifying, driver and constructor data. Useful as a third independent F1 redundancy layer beside OpenF1/Jolpica.

pandascore.note: PandaScore free plan provides fixtures, past/future schedules, tournament/team/player context and pre-match context for esports including Valorant. Detailed historical/post-match statistics require a paid historical plan, so the free tier is useful mainly for schedule/context/redundancy until a suitable free historical surface is proven.

euroleague_basic_free.note: Euroleague Advanced API exposes basic Euroleague/Eurocup endpoints without authentication; advanced analysis requires subscription. Useful for basketball competition-specific redundancy, especially schedule/standings/players/basic game data.

bigballsdata.note: Big Balls Sports Data currently advertises no-card free tiers with API-key access and sport-specific surfaces including basketball, MMA and Formula 1. Coverage is changing and some deeper fields are paid or still in development; use only as a snapshot-tested secondary source.

sportsdataverse_data.note: SportsDataverse publishes refreshed GitHub release assets with timestamp.json provenance. Current release catalog includes NBA, WNBA, men's/women's college basketball play-by-play/box scores/rosters/schedules and NCAA volleyball through its ESPN/NCAA ecosystem. Useful as a reproducible historical research corpus and redundancy layer; source-level PIT must still be reconstructed.

volleystats_dataproject.note: Open-source VolleyStats scrapes Data Project Web Competition pages across many volleyball federations and exports competition/match statistics including serves, receptions, attacks, blocks, errors, coaches and venue. It is not affiliated with Genius Sports; data rights and historical publication timing must be validated before model use.

mma_global_database.note: Public DuckDB/Kaggle corpus reports 129,285 MMA fights from 1993-2026 across 4,300+ organizations, including UFC and Rizin, with 28,118 fights containing technical statistics. Useful for cross-promotion fighter-history features and Rizin/UFC redundancy; snapshot/license/PIT availability remain required.

boxing_data_api.note: Boxing Data API currently advertises a free Basic tier of 100 requests/month with essential fighter/fight data. Key/signup is required and deeper historical coverage is paid. Use only as low-volume independent boxing redundancy until PIT/history/terms are validated.

racinghub.note: RacingHub advertises a free MIT-licensed, no-key F1 REST API built on F1DB, with race/driver/constructor history back to 1950. Useful for F1 static-history redundancy and entity enrichment; prediction-time availability for changing fields must still be separated from static historical facts.

racehooks.note: RaceHooks documents public no-auth F1 historical REST endpoints for results, standings, lap times, tyre stints, pit stops and qualifying laps. Useful as an independent historical F1 redundancy layer; provenance and PIT snapshotting required.

sx_bet.note: SX Bet exposes public read-only market/fixture/league/team/live-score/best-odds data without API key for reads. Current rules cover basketball, tennis, rugby, MMA, esports, boxing and auto racing among relevant families. Do not use wallet/write endpoints. Historical PIT requires archived market/trade timestamps; current retrieval alone is not historical availability evidence.

highlightly.note: Highlightly advertises a free Basic tier of 100 requests/day with no credit card, covering basketball, rugby and volleyball among the project sports. Account/API key registration is required; odds are paid regardless of sport. Treat free data as a research redundancy layer and never auto-create credentials.

sportsdataverse_volleyball.note: SportsDataverse documents NCAA volleyball among NCAA team-sport coverage and supports public data tooling. This is a useful volleyball historical/research route, but exact release coverage and availability timestamps must be validated before PIT/OOS use.

tennis_data_uk.note: Tennis-Data provides 26 years of free computer-ready ATP/WTA results and betting odds, but its current terms explicitly state the files are not for commercial or data-training products using automated bots/scrapers/AI. Therefore useful as discovery evidence of available data, but excluded from model-training ingestion.

balldontlie.note: BALLDONTLIE currently provides a free NBA API tier requiring an API key, with teams/players/games available while player game stats, box scores, odds and advanced endpoints are paid. Useful only for schedule/entity redundancy on this project unless future free-tier scope changes.

statbunker_rugby.note: StatBunker publicly exposes regularly updated rugby-union player/team statistics and historical competition pages. There is no validated historical availability timestamp layer yet, so use only after immutable snapshots and PIT reconstruction.

ufc_official_jsonapi.note: UFC.com exposes a public JSON:API surface documented by a current open-source sports-data integration. It includes event/card resources, athlete profiles, FightMetric career statistics and records, with fighter/event history reaching UFC 1. Treat official site retrieval as public but undocumented: rate-limit and snapshot every retrieval; do not infer historical availability from today's response.

the_odds_api.note: The Odds API advertises a free Starter plan with 500 credits/month and live/upcoming odds across available sports. Current sports pages explicitly include basketball, boxing, MMA and extensive tennis; the free plan excludes historical odds, so use it as prediction-time market context or future-capture source, not as free historical backtest data.
the_odds_api.terms_note: Free account/key required; no paid upgrade or credential creation is automated.

tennis_pointbypoint_legacy.note: Public GitHub archive contains sequential point-by-point ATP/WTA/Challenger/ITF match data split by tour/draw, useful for historical point-sequence modeling. Coverage is strongest for tour-level matches since ~2012/2013 and the repository documents omissions/errors. Treat as a derived research corpus; immutable snapshot and provenance are required.

tennis_match_charting_project.note: Match Charting Project public GitHub data provides shot-by-shot professional tennis records for thousands of matches, including shot type/direction/depth and error information. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; non-commercial. This can support shot-pattern/style features, but historical availability must not be inferred from current aggregates.

tennis_visuals.note: TennisVisuals publishes CSV collections at basic, point-by-point and stats levels. It is a complementary corpus for tennis feature research; source overlap and historical provenance must be audited before using it as an independent validation source.

fightforensics.note: Fight Forensics currently exposes a free read-only MMA JSON API covering large cross-promotion fight history, fighters, events, promotions and venues. API keys are issued for free after repeated bulk-scrape prevention and visible attribution. It can provide cross-promotion fighter-history/entity features; availability snapshots and exact RIZIN coverage must still be verified before use.

lights_out_f1_schedule.note: Lights Out provides a free, no-registration 2026 F1 schedule/results JSON feed under CC BY 4.0. It is intentionally narrow and is useful as an independent current-season calendar/session/result redundancy layer, not as a telemetry replacement.

rizin_club.note: RIZIN.club is a public unofficial RIZIN database covering events, fights, fighter records and decision methods from the 2015 launch through current events, with links to official YouTube videos. Useful as an independent RIZIN redundancy/entity-resolution source; page publication timing must be snapshotted for PIT.

wta_official.note: Official WTA public Spring REST API, no auth/key/Origin-Referer gate. Exposes rankings, player catalogue/profile/match history, tournaments and tournament-edition matches/entry lists. Current public implementation reports live CI probes. Time-sensitive fields must still be snapshotted for PIT replay.

euroleague_official.note: Official EuroLeague live API at api-live.euroleague.net/v2. No key/no signup. Provides seasons, clubs, people, rounds, games and per-game box scores. Historical depth must be established from returned seasons; standings/statistics/PBP are on separate backends.

sporting_events_free.note: Free CSV/JSON fixture datasets with no API key or signup, automatically regenerated, covering basketball, tennis, rugby union, motorsport/F1, MMA, boxing and esports. Commercial use is allowed with attribution. Useful mainly as schedule/context redundancy, not deep player-event statistics.

response_integrity.note: A successful HTTP status is not sufficient evidence of a healthy sports-data response. Current external provider research documents APIs that return HTTP 200 with structured error objects or silently partial data. Probe/ingest paths must inspect body-level error signals, emptiness and completeness where an expected cardinality exists.

grid_valorant_open_access.note: GRID Open Access offers free official esports data and an esports data API for qualifying non-commercial users including researchers, students and independent developers. GRID is Riot's official VALORANT data distribution partner; official Riot pages state community live/fixture data is currently distributed via GRID. Access requires application/account and is not auto-created.

rugby_data_api_legacy.note: Archived MIT rugby-data-api exposes programmatic Rugby Union fixtures/results and league tables for Aviva/Pro12-era data. Repository is archived, so treat it strictly as historical redundancy and not a current feed.

valorant_blitz_static.note: Public GitHub corpus scraped from blitz.gg contains Valorant agent/map/weapon aggregate statistics and map-level metrics. Last repository data refresh is old, so it is useful only for historical feature research and must not be treated as current.

nbaapi_stats.note: Community NBA API exposes no-key JSON player season totals and advanced shooting/box-score metrics. It is an unofficial derived source; useful for NBA-specific feature redundancy, with currentness, provenance and terms requiring validation before use.

tipero_public.note: TIPERO exposes free no-key public tennis prediction/results/stats endpoints. This is an external forecast/consensus signal rather than a raw statistical source; using it as a model feature requires prediction-time snapshotting and historical availability proof to avoid leakage.

source_classes.secondary: free/public enrichment candidate with useful cross-sport or market coverage

volleyball.name: FIVB VIS / Volleyball World public data

independence_policy.rule: Do not count multiple downstream/repackaged surfaces as independent merely because they have different provider names.
